title: Dreams & Goals

expressions.example: Reach for the stars and follow your dreams.
With hard work, the sky's the limit.

sentences: I am going to study abroad next year.
I hope to become a doctor.
We plan to travel next summer.
She will never give up on her dream.
They are going to open a business.
I hope to see progress soon.
We plan to save money for our goals.

grammar.title: Will vs. Going To + Hope To / Plan To
rules: "Will" expressa decisões espontâneas ou previsões: I will achieve my goals.
"Going to" expressa planos já decididos: I am going to study abroad next year.
"Hope to" e "plan to" expressam desejo e intenção: I hope to become a doctor. / We plan to travel next summer.
